correctness.rationale: Every section is f(u)+v g(u), deg f<=2, deg g<=1, over q>=5, t=q-1>=4. A full u=a fiber imposes f(a)=g(a)=0 and W subset V_a=(u-a)<1,u,v>, dimension3. Two full fibers leave at most one-dimensional section, so dimension r>=2 has at most one full fiber. Rank 1 max zeros 2t from quadratic two roots; rank 2 max t+1, with unique W=(u-a)<u-b,v-c> indexed by a != b and b,c nonzero giving t^2(t-1) optimizers. Rank3 either W=V_a with t zeros or has at most one point per fiber: if all t fibers have a common zero, degree<=3 minors f_i g_j-f_j g_i vanish identically; proportional polynomial pairs force dim W<=2, contradiction. Rank4 evaluation at two torus points independent; rank5 constant 1. Therefore all maxima (2t,t+1,t,1,0) and N_r=(t(t-1)/2,t^2(t-1),t,t^2,1), with d_r=t^2-z_r. Independently enumerated all 42,175 subspaces of F5^5 (r totals 781,20306,20306,781,1); all maxima and optimizer counts matched. This finite enumeration supports but does not prove all prime powers.
